# Arnica Heating & Air Conditioning Inc

> > Full-service HVAC contractor serving New York City with heating, cooling, boiler, and ductless system installation and repair across Brooklyn, Manhattan, Queens, and Staten Island.

Arnica Heating & Air Conditioning Inc is an authorized Mitsubishi Electric Diamond Dealer and certified installer for Trane, Carrier, and Burnham Hydronics equipment. The company specializes in both residential and commercial HVAC services throughout the NYC metro area, with expertise in ductless mini-split systems, boiler services, and energy-efficient heating solutions.

- Mitsubishi Electric Ductless Systems
